prompt.text: Hey, can you grab the door? My badge is back in the van. I'm double-parked out there. Two seconds, I swear.

choices.label: Hold it open
choices.bark: The doors swing open. He walks in holding a blank card. The reader stays red.
choices.report: You held the door. He walked in with no badge.

choices.label: The door closes
choices.bark: The doors stay shut. He puts the card away. Badge yourself on the reader.
choices.report: You let the door close. He went back to the van.
